arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-vps-postmerge-hygiene.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 2 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
current="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
test "$current" = 8e1df4ab82856485a8eb565ae73d2965b326bc5b
printf 'POSTMERGE_HEAD=%s\n' "$current"
git diff --check HEAD^ HEAD
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
root=Path('.')
deleted=[
  'ops/coordinator_ai.py',
  'ops/coordinator_media.py',
  'ops/coordinator_phase_continuation.py',
  'ops/coordinator_plan_archive.py',
  'ops/coordinator_pr_integrator.py',
  'ops/coordinator_sealed_relay.py',
  'ops/coordinator_supervisor.py',
  'ops/telegram_coordinator_authority.py',
  'ops/telegram_coordinator_issue.py',
  '.github/workflows/coordinator-owner-order.yml',
  '.github/workflows/coordinator-ai-smoke.yml',
  '.github/workflows/coordinator-phase-cycle.yml',
  '.github/workflows/coordinator-private-media-relay.yml',
  '.github/workflows/telegram-coordinator-owner.yml',
  '.github/workflows/telegram-codex-gateway.yml',
  '.github/workflows/agent-switch.yml',
]
for path in deleted:
 assert not (root/path).exists(),('LEGACY_FOUND',path)
print('COORDINATOR_LEGACY_ABSENT',len(deleted),flush=True)
for path in ('.github/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml',
             '.github/workflows/codex-quota-watch.yml',
             'ops/supervisor_live.py',
             'ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py',
             'ops/supervisor_audit.py',
             'ops/telegram_gateway.py'):
 assert (root/path).is_file(),('PASSIVE_SUPERVISOR_MISSING',path)
print('PASSIVE_SUPERVISOR_FILES_PRESENT=YES',flush=True)
code=(root/'ops/telegram_gateway.py').read_text()
assert 'def poll(' not in code and 'def dispatch_coordinator(' not in code
assert 'getUpdates' not in code
assert "if method not in ('sendMessage', 'sendDocument')" in code
print('TELEGRAM_EGRESS_ONLY=YES',flush=True)
for name in ('codex-chatgpt-bridge.yml','codex-project-leader-safe-fix.yml','codex-autonomous.yml'):
 f=root/'.github/workflows'/name
 if f.is_file():
  s=f.read_text()
  events=s.split('on:\n',1)[1].split('\npermissions:',1)[0].split('\nconcurrency:',1)[0]
  assert '\n  issues:' not in events and '\n  workflow_dispatch:' not in events
  if name=='codex-autonomous.yml':
   assert 'false &&' in s
  print('LEGACY_WORKER_INERT',name,flush=True)
changed=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-status','HEAD^','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()
print('MERGE_CHANGED_FILES',len(changed),flush=True)
print('MERGE_DELETIONS',sum(x.startswith('D\t') for x in changed),flush=True)
PY
python3 -m unittest -q ops.tests.test_portable_coordinator_retirement ops.tests.test_telegram_gateway ops.tests.test_supervisor_live ops.tests.test_supervisor_cloud_source ops.tests.test_supervisor_audit > "$tmp/focused.log" 2>&1
python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/tests -p 'test_*.py' -q > "$tmp/full.log" 2>&1
python3 - "$tmp/focused.log" "$tmp/full.log" <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
 raw=Path(p).read_text(errors='replace')
 for line in raw.splitlines():
  if line.startswith(('Ran ', 'OK', 'FAIL: ', 'ERROR: ', 'FAILED (')):
   print('POSTMERGE_TEST',Path(p).name,line[:200],flush=True)
 assert raw.splitlines()[-1]=='OK',p
PY
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo POSTMERGE_VPS_HYGIENE_CERTIFIED
